title: Chant Grec
identity: Manolis Kalomiris’s Chant Grec is a 1929 vocal-and-piano work later arranged for saxophone and piano. The Leduc AL29479 edition is for alto or soprano saxophone and piano; the Greek Saxophone Library describes a single four-minute movement and lists early college years among its educational stages.

evidence.claim: Greek Saxophone Library gives the 1929 date, four-minute duration, single movement, alto/soprano and piano instrumentation, Leduc edition data and pedagogical descriptors.
Leduc catalog lists AL29479 as alto or soprano saxophone and piano.
A Nakas Conservatory recital archive lists the work in a soprano saxophone and piano performance.

review_focus: Inference: the Greek Saxophone Library identifies legato phrasing, vibrato, dynamic changes and rhythmic variety as study objectives; inspect score to verify the edition’s actual demands.
collection_flag: Adaptation from voice and piano; Leduc edition supports both alto and soprano saxophone.
gaps: Greek Saxophone Library pedagogical stage is contextual and does not determine Tim’s level.
Nakas event page was not fully retrievable.
proposed_corrections: Add alto saxophone and piano; preserve soprano saxophone as an alternate version.
Qualify as arrangement from voice and piano.
